title.rendered: How can I handle VM migrations without breaking the license

content.rendered: Licenses for commercial products are bound to a specific System ID, which is a unique host identifier. System ID, being based on the hardware configuration, is subject to change on Virtual Machines when migrating them across different hosts. However, since July 21st 2021, those changes to the System ID due to Virtual Machine live migration is handled transparently, so no action is required in this case.
